sourceText:
Broccoli And Beef
By: Leah Rodrigues
Published: Tuesday, December 29, 2009 - 11:16pm

Ingredients




1 pound fresh broccoli
3 ounces oyster sauce
Garlic to taste
2 tablespoons corn starch
2 tablespoons soy sauce
3/4 pound fillet of beef cut in ½" strips

Preparation

1 Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok; brown beef. Remove beef and set aside. Add broccoli, soy sauce and cook for about 15 minutes. Dissolve corn starch in 1/4 to 1/2 cup water; add with remaining ingredients including beef. Let simmer for about 5 to 7 minutes. Serve over noodles.
